		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea = { sr_site_aut_step_hygiea = yes }
	}
}

# --- Io (io), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_io = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_io
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_io ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_io }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_io ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_io = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_io
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_io = { sr_site_mirror_on_io = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_io value = global_var:sr_site_holder_io }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_io = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_io >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining MULT = sr_site_mult_a_io }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_io >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research MULT = sr_site_mult_b_io }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof global_var:sr_site_disc_io_roof = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof global_var:sr_site_disc_io_roof = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_io = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_io } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_io }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 11 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_io = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io }
	sr_site_sync_io = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_io } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_io }
	sr_site_clear_ties_io = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released io"
}
# Moves Io to scope:sr_site_to_io; scope:sr_site_from_io, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_io = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_io value = scope:sr_site_to_io }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_io }
		sr_site_sync_io = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_io = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 11 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_io ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 11 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_io = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_io value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_io }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder io: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder io: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_io ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_io }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_io }
			sr_site_transfer_io = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder io: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_io = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_io
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_io_mining_held has_variable = sr_colony_io_research_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_io
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_io }
			sr_site_transfer_io = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_io = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_io = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io }
		sr_site_free_step_io = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io
			global_var:sr_site_pop_io > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_io }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_io >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_io
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_io
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_io
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_io = { sr_site_aut_step_io = yes }
	}
}

			sr_site_transfer_europa = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder europa: the heir did not take it"
			}

		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_europa = yes
		}

	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_europa }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_europa_drilling_held has_variable = sr_colony_europa_surface_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_europa
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_europa }
			sr_site_transfer_europa = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_europa = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_europa = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_europa }
		sr_site_free_step_europa = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_europa
			global_var:sr_site_pop_europa > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_europa }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_europa >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_europa
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_europa
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_europa
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_europa = { sr_site_aut_step_europa = yes }
	}
}

# --- Ganymede (ganymede), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_ganymede = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ganymede
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ganymede }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_ganymede ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_ganymede ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_ganymede = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ganymede
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede = { sr_site_mirror_on_ganymede = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_ganymede value = global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_ganymede = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_ganymede >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_settlement MULT = sr_site_mult_a_ganymede }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_settlement }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_ganymede >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_command MULT = sr_site_mult_b_ganymede }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_command }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers global_var:sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = ganymede_layers }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers global_var:sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = ganymede_layers }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = ganymede_layers }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_ganymede = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_settlement }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ganymede_command }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ganymede_layers_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = ganymede_layers }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_ganymede } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_ganymede }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 13 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_ganymede = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ganymede }
	sr_site_sync_ganymede = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ganymede_layers_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_ganymede }
	sr_site_clear_ties_ganymede = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released ganymede"
}
# Moves Ganymede to scope:sr_site_to_ganymede; scope:sr_site_from_ganymede, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_ganymede = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_ganymede ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_ganymede value = scope:sr_site_to_ganymede }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ganymede } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ganymede }
		sr_site_sync_ganymede = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_ganymede = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 13 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_ganymede ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 13 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_ganymede = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_ganymede value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ganymede
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder ganymede: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder ganymede: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_ganymede ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_ganymede }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_ganymede }
			sr_site_transfer_ganymede = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder ganymede: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_ganymede = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ganymede }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_ganymede_settlement_held has_variable = sr_colony_ganymede_command_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_ganymede
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_ganymede }
			sr_site_transfer_ganymede = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_ganymede = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_ganymede = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede }
		sr_site_free_step_ganymede = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ganymede
			global_var:sr_site_pop_ganymede > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ganymede }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_ganymede >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_ganymede
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_ganymede
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_ganymede
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede = { sr_site_aut_step_ganymede = yes }
	}
}

		sr_site_free_step_callisto = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_callisto
			global_var:sr_site_pop_callisto > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_callisto >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_callisto
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_callisto
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_callisto
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto = { sr_site_aut_step_callisto = yes }
	}
}

# --- Himalia (himalia), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_himalia = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_himalia
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_himalia ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_himalia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_himalia = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_himalia
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia = { sr_site_mirror_on_himalia = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_himalia value = global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_himalia = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_himalia >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope MULT = sr_site_mult_a_himalia }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_himalia >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot MULT = sr_site_mult_b_himalia }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_himalia = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_himalia } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_himalia }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 15 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_himalia = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia }
	sr_site_sync_himalia = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_himalia }
	sr_site_clear_ties_himalia = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released himalia"
}
# Moves Himalia to scope:sr_site_to_himalia; scope:sr_site_from_himalia, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_himalia = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_himalia value = scope:sr_site_to_himalia }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_himalia }
		sr_site_sync_himalia = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_himalia = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 15 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_himalia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 15 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_himalia = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_himalia value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder himalia: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder himalia: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_himalia ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_himalia }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_himalia }
			sr_site_transfer_himalia = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder himalia: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_himalia = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_himalia_telescope_held has_variable = sr_colony_himalia_depot_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_himalia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_himalia }
			sr_site_transfer_himalia = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_himalia = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_himalia = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
		sr_site_free_step_himalia = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_himalia
			global_var:sr_site_pop_himalia > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_himalia }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_himalia >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_himalia
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_himalia
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_himalia
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia = { sr_site_aut_step_himalia = yes }
	}
}

# --- Venus Cloud Habitat (venus), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_venus = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_venus
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_venus ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_venus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_venus = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_venus
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_venus = { sr_site_mirror_on_venus = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_venus value = global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_venus = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_venus >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric MULT = sr_site_mult_a_venus }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_venus >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction MULT = sr_site_mult_b_venus }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves global_var:sr_site_disc_venus_waves = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves global_var:sr_site_disc_venus_waves = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_venus = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_venus } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_venus }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 17 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_venus = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
	sr_site_sync_venus = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_venus }
	sr_site_clear_ties_venus = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released venus"
}
# Moves Venus Cloud Habitat to scope:sr_site_to_venus; scope:sr_site_from_venus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_venus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_venus value = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_venus }
		sr_site_sync_venus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_venus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 17 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_venus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 17 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_venus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_venus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder venus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder venus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_venus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_venus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
			sr_site_transfer_venus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder venus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_venus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric_held has_variable = sr_colony_venus_extraction_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_venus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
			sr_site_transfer_venus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_venus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_venus = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus }
		sr_site_free_step_venus = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_venus > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_venus }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_venus >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_venus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_venus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_venus
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_venus = { sr_site_aut_step_venus = yes }
	}
}

# --- Mercury (mercury), stage 3 ---
sr_site_sync_mercury = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mercury
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_mercury }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_mercury ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_mercury ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_mercury = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mercury
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury = { sr_site_mirror_on_mercury = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_mercury value = global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_mercury = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_mercury >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar MULT = sr_site_mult_a_mercury }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_mercury >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice MULT = sr_site_mult_b_mercury }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive global_var:sr_site_disc_mercury_archive = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive global_var:sr_site_disc_mercury_archive = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}

	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice }

		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titan_hydrocarbons }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_titan >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titan_prebiotic MULT = sr_site_mult_b_titan }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titan_prebiotic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry global_var:sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titan_chemistry }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry global_var:sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titan_chemistry }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = titan_chemistry }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_titan = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titan_hydrocarbons }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titan_prebiotic }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titan_chemistry_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = titan_chemistry }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_titan } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_titan }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 19 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_titan = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan }
	sr_site_sync_titan = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titan_chemistry_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_titan }
	sr_site_clear_ties_titan = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released titan"
}
# Moves Titan to scope:sr_site_to_titan; scope:sr_site_from_titan, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_titan = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_titan ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_titan value = scope:sr_site_to_titan }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan }
		sr_site_sync_titan = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_titan = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 19 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_titan ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 19 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_titan = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_titan value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_titan }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder titan: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder titan: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_titan ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_titan }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_titan }
			sr_site_transfer_titan = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder titan: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_titan = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_titan
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_titan_hydrocarbons_held has_variable = sr_colony_titan_prebiotic_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_titan
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_titan }
			sr_site_transfer_titan = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_titan = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_titan = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
		sr_site_free_step_titan = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titan
			global_var:sr_site_pop_titan > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_titan >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_titan
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_titan
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_titan
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_titan = { sr_site_aut_step_titan = yes }
	}
}

# --- Enceladus (enceladus), stage 3 ---
sr_site_sync_enceladus = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_enceladus
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_enceladus }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_enceladus ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_enceladus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_enceladus = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_enceladus
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus = { sr_site_mirror_on_enceladus = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_enceladus value = global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_enceladus = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_enceladus >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_astrobiology MULT = sr_site_mult_a_enceladus }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_astrobiology }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_enceladus >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_water MULT = sr_site_mult_b_enceladus }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_water }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life global_var:sr_site_disc_enceladus_life = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life global_var:sr_site_disc_enceladus_life = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}

	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_rhea >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant MULT = sr_site_mult_a_rhea }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_rhea >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation MULT = sr_site_mult_b_rhea }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_rhea = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_rhea } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_rhea }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 21 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_rhea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea }
	sr_site_sync_rhea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_rhea }
	sr_site_clear_ties_rhea = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released rhea"
}
# Moves Rhea to scope:sr_site_to_rhea; scope:sr_site_from_rhea, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_rhea = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_rhea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_rhea value = scope:sr_site_to_rhea }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_rhea }
		sr_site_sync_rhea = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_rhea = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 21 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_rhea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 21 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_rhea = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_rhea value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder rhea: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder rhea: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_rhea ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_rhea }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_rhea }
			sr_site_transfer_rhea = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder rhea: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_rhea = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_rhea_propellant_held has_variable = sr_colony_rhea_observation_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_rhea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_rhea }
			sr_site_transfer_rhea = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_rhea = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_rhea = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea }
		sr_site_free_step_rhea = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea
			global_var:sr_site_pop_rhea > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_rhea }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_rhea >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_rhea
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_rhea
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_rhea
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea = { sr_site_aut_step_rhea = yes }
	}
}

# --- Mimas (mimas), stage 3 ---
sr_site_sync_mimas = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mimas
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_mimas }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_mimas ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_mimas ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_mimas = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mimas
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas = { sr_site_mirror_on_mimas = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_mimas value = global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_mimas = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_mimas >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_installation MULT = sr_site_mult_a_mimas }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_installation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_mimas >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_gravity MULT = sr_site_mult_b_mimas }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_gravity }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_mimas = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_installation }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mimas_gravity }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_mimas } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_mimas }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 22 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_mimas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_mimas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_mimas }
	sr_site_clear_ties_mimas = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released mimas"

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_iapetus }
	sr_site_clear_ties_iapetus = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released iapetus"
}
# Moves Iapetus to scope:sr_site_to_iapetus; scope:sr_site_from_iapetus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_iapetus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_iapetus value = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_iapetus }
		sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_iapetus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 23 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_iapetus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 23 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_iapetus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_iapetus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder iapetus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder iapetus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_iapetus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_iapetus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
			sr_site_transfer_iapetus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder iapetus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_iapetus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_iapetus_ridge_held has_variable = sr_colony_iapetus_organics_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_iapetus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
			sr_site_transfer_iapetus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_iapetus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus }
		sr_site_free_step_iapetus = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_iapetus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_iapetus > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_iapetus >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_iapetus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_iapetus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_iapetus
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus = { sr_site_aut_step_iapetus = yes }
	}
}

# --- Titania (titania), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_titania = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_titania
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_titania ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_titania }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_titania ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_titania = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_titania
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_titania = { sr_site_mirror_on_titania = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_titania value = global_var:sr_site_holder_titania }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_titania = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_titania >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining MULT = sr_site_mult_a_titania }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_titania >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics MULT = sr_site_mult_b_titania }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean global_var:sr_site_disc_titania_ocean = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean global_var:sr_site_disc_titania_ocean = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_titania = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_titania } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_titania }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 24 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_titania = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania }
	sr_site_sync_titania = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_titania }
	sr_site_clear_ties_titania = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released titania"
}
