			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 25 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_oberon = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_oberon value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_oberon
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder oberon: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder oberon: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_oberon ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_oberon }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_oberon }
			sr_site_transfer_oberon = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder oberon: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_oberon = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_oberon
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_oberon }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_oberon }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_oberon_relay_held has_variable = sr_colony_oberon_research_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_oberon
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_oberon }
			sr_site_transfer_oberon = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_oberon = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_oberon = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_oberon }
		sr_site_free_step_oberon = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_oberon
			global_var:sr_site_pop_oberon > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_oberon }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_oberon >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_oberon
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_oberon
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_oberon
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon = { sr_site_aut_step_oberon = yes }
	}
}

# --- Miranda (miranda), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_miranda = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_miranda
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_miranda ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_miranda ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_miranda = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_miranda
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda = { sr_site_mirror_on_miranda = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_miranda value = global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_miranda = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_miranda >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_rupes MULT = sr_site_mult_a_miranda }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_rupes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_miranda >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_drilling MULT = sr_site_mult_b_miranda }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_drilling }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_miranda = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_rupes }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_miranda_drilling }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_miranda } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_miranda }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 26 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_miranda = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda }
	sr_site_sync_miranda = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_miranda }
	sr_site_clear_ties_miranda = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released miranda"
}
# Moves Miranda to scope:sr_site_to_miranda; scope:sr_site_from_miranda, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_miranda = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_miranda ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_miranda value = scope:sr_site_to_miranda }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_miranda }
		sr_site_sync_miranda = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_miranda = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 26 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_miranda ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 26 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}

		sr_site_free_step_ariel = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ariel
			global_var:sr_site_pop_ariel > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ariel }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_ariel >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_ariel
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_ariel
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_ariel
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel = { sr_site_aut_step_ariel = yes }
	}
}

# --- Triton (triton), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_triton = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_triton
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_triton ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_triton }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_triton ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_triton = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_triton
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_triton = { sr_site_mirror_on_triton = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_triton value = global_var:sr_site_holder_triton }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_triton = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_triton >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser MULT = sr_site_mult_a_triton }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_triton >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway MULT = sr_site_mult_b_triton }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet global_var:sr_site_disc_triton_jet = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet global_var:sr_site_disc_triton_jet = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_triton = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_triton } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_triton }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 28 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_triton = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
	sr_site_sync_triton = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_triton }
	sr_site_clear_ties_triton = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released triton"
}
# Moves Triton to scope:sr_site_to_triton; scope:sr_site_from_triton, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_triton = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_triton value = scope:sr_site_to_triton }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton }
		sr_site_sync_triton = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_triton = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 28 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_triton ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 28 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_triton = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_triton value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_triton }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder triton: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder triton: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_triton ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_triton }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_triton }
			sr_site_transfer_triton = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder triton: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_triton = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_triton_geyser_held has_variable = sr_colony_triton_gateway_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_triton
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_triton }
			sr_site_transfer_triton = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_triton = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_triton = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton }
		sr_site_free_step_triton = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_triton
			global_var:sr_site_pop_triton > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_triton >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_triton
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_triton
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_triton
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_triton = { sr_site_aut_step_triton = yes }
	}
}

# --- Pluto-Charon (pluto), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_pluto = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_pluto
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_pluto ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_pluto ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_pluto = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_pluto
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto = { sr_site_mirror_on_pluto = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_pluto value = global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_pluto = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_pluto >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research MULT = sr_site_mult_a_pluto }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_pluto >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting MULT = sr_site_mult_b_pluto }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze global_var:sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze global_var:sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_pluto = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_pluto } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_pluto }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 30 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_pluto = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto }
	sr_site_sync_pluto = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_pluto }
	sr_site_clear_ties_pluto = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released pluto"
}
# Moves Pluto-Charon to scope:sr_site_to_pluto; scope:sr_site_from_pluto, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_pluto = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_pluto value = scope:sr_site_to_pluto }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_pluto }
		sr_site_sync_pluto = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_pluto = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 30 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_pluto ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 30 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_pluto = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_pluto value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder pluto: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder pluto: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_pluto ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_pluto }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_pluto }
			sr_site_transfer_pluto = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder pluto: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_pluto = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_pluto_research_held has_variable = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_pluto
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_pluto }
			sr_site_transfer_pluto = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_pluto = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_pluto = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto }
		sr_site_free_step_pluto = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pluto
			global_var:sr_site_pop_pluto > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_pluto }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_pluto >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_pluto
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_pluto
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_pluto
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto = { sr_site_aut_step_pluto = yes }
	}
}

# --- Eris (eris), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_eris = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_eris
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_eris }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_eris ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_eris }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_eris ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_eris = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_eris
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_eris = { sr_site_mirror_on_eris = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_eris value = global_var:sr_site_holder_eris }
	}
}

		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_eris >= 1 }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_eris }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_eris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_eris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_eris }

# --- Makemake (makemake), stage 5 ---

	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_makemake
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_makemake ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_makemake ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_makemake = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_makemake
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake = { sr_site_mirror_on_makemake = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_makemake value = global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_makemake = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_makemake >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_chemistry MULT = sr_site_mult_a_makemake }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_chemistry }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_makemake >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_solarwind MULT = sr_site_mult_b_makemake }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_solarwind }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_makemake = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_chemistry }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_makemake_solarwind }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_makemake } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_makemake }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 32 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_makemake = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake }
	sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_makemake }
	sr_site_clear_ties_makemake = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released makemake"
}
# Moves Makemake to scope:sr_site_to_makemake; scope:sr_site_from_makemake, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_makemake = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_makemake value = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake }
		sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_makemake = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 32 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_makemake ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 32 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_makemake = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_makemake value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder makemake: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder makemake: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_makemake ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_makemake }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
			sr_site_transfer_makemake = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder makemake: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_makemake = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_makemake_chemistry_held has_variable = sr_colony_makemake_solarwind_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_makemake
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
			sr_site_transfer_makemake = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_makemake = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake }
		sr_site_free_step_makemake = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake
			global_var:sr_site_pop_makemake > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_makemake >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_makemake
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_makemake
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_makemake
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake = { sr_site_aut_step_makemake = yes }
	}
}

# --- Haumea (haumea), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_haumea = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_haumea
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_haumea ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_haumea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_haumea = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_haumea
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea = { sr_site_mirror_on_haumea = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_haumea value = global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_haumea = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics MULT = sr_site_mult_a_haumea }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea >= 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings MULT = sr_site_mult_b_haumea }
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_haumea = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics }
	sr_site_hide_modifier_at = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_haumea } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_haumea }
	sr_mq_drop_site = { INDEX = 33 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_haumea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea }
	sr_site_sync_haumea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_hab_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_def_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_port_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_contact_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_born_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_born_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_petition_haumea }
	sr_site_clear_ties_haumea = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released haumea"
}

		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_sedna value = scope:sr_site_to_sedna }
		# The garrison is its holder's and goes home (slice 5 design § 1).
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_sedna }
		sr_site_sync_sedna = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_sedna = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 34 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_sedna ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 34 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_sedna = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_sedna value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder sedna: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder sedna: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_sedna ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_sedna }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_sedna }
			sr_site_transfer_sedna = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder sedna: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		# No heir: a world with people becomes a free colony under simple and full
		# (slice 5 design § 5), any other is released.
		else = {
			sr_site_free_or_release_sedna = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder (a free colony aside): a country showing it adopts it;
	# after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_sedna }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_sedna_outpost_held has_variable = sr_colony_sedna_interstellar_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_sedna
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_sedna }
			sr_site_transfer_sedna = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_sedna = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_sedna = yes
	# 5. A free colony: its suppliers, their ties, a petition (slice 5 design § 3).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_sedna }
		sr_site_free_step_sedna = yes
	}
	# 6. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2); at a
	# free colony only while someone supplies it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_sedna
			global_var:sr_site_pop_sedna > 0
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_sedna }
				sr_site_suppliers_value_sedna >= 1
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_sedna
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_sedna
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_sedna
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. A held colony's autonomy (simple and full; slice 5 design § 2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna = { sr_site_aut_step_sedna = yes }
	}
}

# ===== The choice dispatcher =====
# sr_grant_colony_modifier = { MODIFIER = m } calls sr_site_choose_<m>: a
# specialization records the world's choice, a discovery outcome the
# discovery's. ROOT is the country choosing. A world claimed under a save
# from before the record existed gets its holder here.

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research_mult value = 1 }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
}

# saved. The world whose building type is the input, if the source still
# holds it, goes to the target.

		limit = {
			scope:article_options.input_building_type ?= bt:building_sr_site_valles_marineris

		}

# Release ROOT's first colony, as a dead holder with no heir would.
sr_sites_debug_release_first_held = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= root }
		sr_site_release_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= root }
		sr_site_release_olympus_mons = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= root }
		sr_site_release_hellas_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= root }
		sr_site_release_utopia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= root }
		sr_site_release_arcadia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= root }
		sr_site_release_ceres = yes
	}

# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 3-9) =====
# Per world: founding by THIS, a fleet's dispatch, a races-only target founded at
# once, a landing, and the inbound record. Dispatchers by index follow; the
# shared parts (slots, the launch month, notices) are hand-written in
# sr_colony_fleet_effects.txt.

# --- Valles Marineris ---
# THIS founds Valles Marineris: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_valles_marineris = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_valles_marineris value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.1 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Valles Marineris: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_valles_marineris = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_valles_marineris = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}
# THIS's fleet bound for Valles Marineris lands: the world if free, else another of its body, else lost.
sr_cf_arrive_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } }
		sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } }
		sr_site_found_olympus_mons = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 2 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_hellas_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 3 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_utopia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 4 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_arcadia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 5 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 1 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_valles_marineris value = this }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea } }
		sr_site_found_haumea = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 33 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto } }
		sr_site_found_pluto = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 30 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 33 FOUNDED = 30 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_eris } }
		sr_site_found_eris = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 31 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 33 FOUNDED = 31 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake } }
		sr_site_found_makemake = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 32 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 33 FOUNDED = 32 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna } }
		sr_site_found_sedna = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 34 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 33 FOUNDED = 34 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 33 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_haumea = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_haumea } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_haumea value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_haumea add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_haumea }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_haumea > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_haumea value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_haumea value = this }
	}
}

# --- Sedna ---
# THIS founds Sedna: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_sedna = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_sedna value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_sedna value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_sedna value = te_history_month_index }
	sr_site_sync_sedna = yes
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.34 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Sedna: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_sedna = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 34 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_sedna }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_sedna }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = kuiper }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_sedna = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_sedna }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_sedna = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = kuiper }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}

		sr_cf_found_now_iapetus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 24 }
		sr_cf_found_now_titania = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 }
		sr_cf_found_now_oberon = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 }
		sr_cf_found_now_miranda = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 }
		sr_cf_found_now_ariel = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 28 }
		sr_cf_found_now_triton = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 29 }
		sr_cf_found_now_proteus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 30 }
		sr_cf_found_now_pluto = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 31 }
		sr_cf_found_now_eris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 32 }
		sr_cf_found_now_makemake = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 33 }
		sr_cf_found_now_haumea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 34 }
		sr_cf_found_now_sedna = yes
	}

	# A site was claimed: the site's sync has counted it for this country.
	# The national/international charter story follows a real first colony.
	# Delay it past the location's own specialization event (duration = 3).
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_colonies_claimed_before < sr_total_global_colonies }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:sr_colony_count = 1
				NOT = { has_variable = ste_event_18_fired }
			}
			set_variable = { name = sr_colony_charter_pending value = yes days = 14 }
			trigger_event = { id = society_technology_events.18 days = 7 }
		}
	}

	# Check stage advancement after establishing colony
	sr_check_colony_stage_effect = yes
}

# Simple and full: the global stage is the lowest with an unclaimed world, and
# the race is complete once none is left (design § 9). Worlds are claimed out
# of order there, so the races-only step-by-one stage check would stall.
sr_sites_recompute_stage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_vesta }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_psyche }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hygiea }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_io }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_mercury }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titan }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_mimas }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_oberon }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_proteus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_eris }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 5 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_all_colonies_complete value = yes }
	}
}

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
# The month's emigrants (local_var:sr_emig_sent, people), shared out among
# THIS's colonies by weight (sr_emig_weight_<key>) over the sum
# (local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum), each capped at its free room. A colony
# the cap holds back passes the rest on: the next pass shares what is left
# among the colonies with room (a full colony weighs 0). The month never
# sends more than the open colonies' free room, and each pass either lands
# everyone left or fills a colony, so every settler lands within one pass
# per world (34).
sr_emig_distribute = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left value = local_var:sr_emig_sent }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_passes value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			local_var:sr_emig_left >= 1
			local_var:sr_emig_passes < 34
			sr_emig_weight_total > 0
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_passes add = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_pass value = local_var:sr_emig_left }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_weight_sum value = sr_emig_weight_total }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_olympus_mons
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_olympus_mons value = te_history_month_index }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {

				value = {

					multiply = sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_hellas_planitia

			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia add = local_var:sr_emig_share }

		if = {

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 5-7, 10) =====
# Per world: a landing's install and the AI's plan; then the queue, first in first
# out, and dispatchers by index. The shared parts (the month, the shipment slots,
# the AI's review) are hand-written in sr_colony_module_effects.txt.

# --- Valles Marineris ---
# A module lands at Valles Marineris (local_var:sr_ms_type_now): installed for whoever holds
# the world while its cap has room, else lost (design § 6).
sr_mod_install_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 1 sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris value = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 2 sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris value = { value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 3 sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris < 4 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_hab_valles_marineris value = { value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 4 sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris < 4 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_def_valles_marineris value = { value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 5 sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris < 4 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_port_valles_marineris value = { value = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index }
		sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	}
}
sr_mod_ai_plan_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this
			NOT = { sr_mq_any_valles_marineris = yes }
			NOT = { sr_site_shipping_valles_marineris = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				sr_mod_can_queue_hab_valles_marineris = yes
				sr_site_fill_valles_marineris >= 0.75
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = hab INDEX = 1 CODE = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
				global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_valles_marineris = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_valles_marineris >= sr_site_levels_valles_marineris has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = a INDEX = 1 CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
				global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_valles_marineris = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_valles_marineris >= sr_site_levels_valles_marineris has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = b INDEX = 1 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
				global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_valles_marineris = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_valles_marineris >= sr_site_levels_valles_marineris has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = b INDEX = 1 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris
				global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_valles_marineris = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_valles_marineris >= sr_site_levels_valles_marineris has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = a INDEX = 1 CODE = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= this

			}

				global_var:sr_site_spec_iapetus = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_iapetus = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_iapetus >= sr_site_levels_iapetus has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }

			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = iapetus TYPE = a INDEX = 23 CODE = 1 }

# --- Titania ---
# A module lands at Titania (local_var:sr_ms_type_now): installed for whoever holds
# the world while its cap has room, else lost (design § 6).
sr_mod_install_titania = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 1 sr_site_spec_built_titania < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_a_titania value = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_titania add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 2 sr_site_spec_built_titania < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_b_titania value = { value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_titania add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 3 sr_site_generic_built_titania < 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_hab_titania value = { value = sr_site_hab_value_titania add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 4 sr_site_generic_built_titania < 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_def_titania value = { value = sr_site_def_value_titania add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 5 sr_site_generic_built_titania < 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_port_titania value = { value = sr_site_port_value_titania add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_titania value = te_history_month_index }
		sr_site_sync_titania = yes
	}
}

# the world while its cap has room, else lost (design § 6).
sr_mod_install_proteus = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_proteus }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 1 sr_site_spec_built_proteus < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_a_proteus value = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_proteus add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 2 sr_site_spec_built_proteus < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_b_proteus value = { value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_proteus add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 3 sr_site_generic_built_proteus < 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_hab_proteus value = { value = sr_site_hab_value_proteus add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 4 sr_site_generic_built_proteus < 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_def_proteus value = { value = sr_site_def_value_proteus add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 5 sr_site_generic_built_proteus < 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_port_proteus value = { value = sr_site_port_value_proteus add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_proteus value = te_history_month_index }
		sr_site_sync_proteus = yes
	}
}
sr_mod_ai_plan_proteus = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this
			NOT = { sr_mq_any_proteus = yes }
			NOT = { sr_site_shipping_proteus = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				sr_mod_can_queue_hab_proteus = yes
				sr_site_fill_proteus >= 0.75
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = proteus TYPE = hab INDEX = 29 CODE = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_proteus
				global_var:sr_site_spec_proteus = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_proteus = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_proteus >= sr_site_levels_proteus has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = proteus TYPE = a INDEX = 29 CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_proteus
				global_var:sr_site_spec_proteus = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_proteus = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_proteus >= sr_site_levels_proteus has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = proteus TYPE = b INDEX = 29 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_proteus
				global_var:sr_site_spec_proteus = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_proteus = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_proteus >= sr_site_levels_proteus has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = proteus TYPE = b INDEX = 29 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_proteus
				global_var:sr_site_spec_proteus = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_proteus = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_proteus >= sr_site_levels_proteus has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = proteus TYPE = a INDEX = 29 CODE = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# --- Pluto-Charon ---

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 1 sr_site_spec_built_pluto < sr_mod_spec_budget }

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 2 sr_site_spec_built_pluto < sr_mod_spec_budget }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_lvl_b_pluto value = { value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_pluto add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ms_type_now = 3 sr_site_generic_built_pluto < 2 }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_hab_pluto value = { value = sr_site_hab_value_pluto add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {

			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_port_pluto value = { value = sr_site_port_value_pluto add = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ms_installed value = 1 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_pluto value = te_history_month_index }
		sr_site_sync_pluto = yes
	}
}

			global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this
			NOT = { sr_mq_any_sedna = yes }
			NOT = { sr_site_shipping_sedna = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				sr_mod_can_queue_hab_sedna = yes
				sr_site_fill_sedna >= 0.75
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = sedna TYPE = hab INDEX = 34 CODE = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna
				global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_sedna = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_sedna >= sr_site_levels_sedna has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = sedna TYPE = a INDEX = 34 CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna
				global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 1
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_sedna = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_sedna >= sr_site_levels_sedna has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = sedna TYPE = b INDEX = 34 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna
				global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_b_sedna = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_sedna >= sr_site_levels_sedna has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = sedna TYPE = b INDEX = 34 CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna
				global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 2
				sr_mod_can_queue_a_sedna = yes
				OR = { sr_site_crews_sedna >= sr_site_levels_sedna has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence }
			}
			sr_mod_queue = { KEY = sedna TYPE = a INDEX = 34 CODE = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# ===== The module queue (first in first out) =====
# Places 1 to 20: sr_mq_<n>_site (a world's index) and sr_mq_<n>_type (the module's
# code: 1 the first specialization, 2 the second, 3 Habitat, 4 Defences, 5 Spaceport),
# filled from place 1 without gaps. The per-world counts (sr_mq_<type>_<key>) follow
# it: added to by sr_mod_queue, recounted after every removal and monthly.

# A new entry (local_var:sr_mq_new_site, local_var:sr_mq_new_type) in the first free
# place; the caller has checked one is free (sr_mq_has_room).
