# Every entry for the world INDEX leaves the queue (its row's clear button; the
# unmirror, when the world leaves THIS), then the counts.
sr_mq_drop_site = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_mq_passes value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			local_var:sr_mq_passes < 20
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_1_site var:sr_mq_1_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_2_site var:sr_mq_2_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_3_site var:sr_mq_3_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_4_site var:sr_mq_4_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_5_site var:sr_mq_5_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_6_site var:sr_mq_6_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_7_site var:sr_mq_7_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_8_site var:sr_mq_8_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_9_site var:sr_mq_9_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_10_site var:sr_mq_10_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_11_site var:sr_mq_11_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_12_site var:sr_mq_12_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_13_site var:sr_mq_13_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_14_site var:sr_mq_14_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_15_site var:sr_mq_15_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_16_site var:sr_mq_16_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_17_site var:sr_mq_17_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_18_site var:sr_mq_18_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_19_site var:sr_mq_19_site = $INDEX$ }
				AND = { has_variable = sr_mq_20_site var:sr_mq_20_site = $INDEX$ }
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_mq_passes add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_1_site var:sr_mq_1_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_1 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_2_site var:sr_mq_2_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_2 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_3_site var:sr_mq_3_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_3 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_4_site var:sr_mq_4_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_4 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_5_site var:sr_mq_5_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_5 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_6_site var:sr_mq_6_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_6 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_7_site var:sr_mq_7_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_7 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_8_site var:sr_mq_8_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_8 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_9_site var:sr_mq_9_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_9 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_10_site var:sr_mq_10_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_10 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_11_site var:sr_mq_11_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_11 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_12_site var:sr_mq_12_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_12 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_13_site var:sr_mq_13_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_13 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_14_site var:sr_mq_14_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_14 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_15_site var:sr_mq_15_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_15 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_16_site var:sr_mq_16_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_16 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_17_site var:sr_mq_17_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_17 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_18_site var:sr_mq_18_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_18 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_19_site var:sr_mq_19_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_19 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_20_site var:sr_mq_20_site = $INDEX$ }
			sr_mq_remove_20 = yes
		}
	}
	sr_mq_recount = yes
}

# Fabrication builds the queue's first entry (sr_mod_month has checked there is one
# and the stock covers it). It leaves the queue first; an entry for a world THIS no
# longer holds is dropped unbuilt.
sr_mod_fab_head = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_mq_head_site value = var:sr_mq_1_site }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_mq_head_type value = var:sr_mq_1_type }
	sr_mq_remove_1 = yes
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_site = 1 global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 3 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = hab CODE = 3 INDEX = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 1 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = a CODE = 1 INDEX = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 2 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = b CODE = 2 INDEX = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 5 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = port CODE = 5 INDEX = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 4 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = valles_marineris TYPE = def CODE = 4 INDEX = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_site = 2 global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 3 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = olympus_mons TYPE = hab CODE = 3 INDEX = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 1 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = olympus_mons TYPE = a CODE = 1 INDEX = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 2 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = olympus_mons TYPE = b CODE = 2 INDEX = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 5 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = olympus_mons TYPE = port CODE = 5 INDEX = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { local_var:sr_mq_head_type = 4 } sr_mod_fab_build = { KEY = olympus_mons TYPE = def CODE = 4 INDEX = 2 } }
	}
	else_if = {

# Every world's shipments on their way, cleared before the monthly rebuild
# (sr_ms_global_after) and counted again from every country's slots.
sr_ms_clear_counters = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_hellas_planitia }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_utopia_planitia }

}

		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_take value = { value = local_var:sr_eb_left max = 10 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_sum value = { value = local_var:sr_eb_take multiply = -40 add = local_var:sr_eb_sum } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_left subtract = local_var:sr_eb_take }
	}
	# Sedna: 10 levels at -45%
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_eb_left > 0 global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_take value = { value = local_var:sr_eb_left max = 10 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_sum value = { value = local_var:sr_eb_take multiply = -45 add = local_var:sr_eb_sum } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_left subtract = local_var:sr_eb_take }
	}
	# Past all of it
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_eb_left > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_sum value = { value = local_var:sr_eb_left multiply = -50 add = local_var:sr_eb_sum } }
	}
}

# ===== Autonomy, free colonies, abandonment, colony life (slice 5 design) =====
# Per world: free or release, freedom, a rejoin, the ties' clearing, a free world's
# month and a held world's autonomy; then dispatchers by index and by scope, the
# covert hooks, the life events' draw, the AI's supply pick and the console's
# helpers. The shared parts are hand-written in sr_colony_autonomy_effects.txt.

# --- Valles Marineris ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_valles_marineris = yes
	}
}
# Valles Marineris becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_valles_marineris = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_valles_marineris value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_valles_marineris }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES valles_marineris is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Valles Marineris back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris }
	sr_site_clear_ties_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 1 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Valles Marineris and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_valles_marineris = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris has_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris }
	}
}
# Valles Marineris free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_valles_marineris = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris has_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = valles_marineris }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = valles_marineris }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_valles_marineris >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_valles_marineris }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_valles_marineris = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_valles_marineris value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_valles_marineris = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 1 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Valles Marineris: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = valles_marineris INDEX = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_valles_marineris }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_valles_marineris value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 1 }
	}
}

# --- Olympus Mons ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_olympus_mons = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_olympus_mons = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_olympus_mons = yes
	}
}
# Olympus Mons becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_olympus_mons = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_olympus_mons value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_olympus_mons }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES olympus_mons is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Olympus Mons back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_olympus_mons = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_olympus_mons }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_olympus_mons value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }

	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes

}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_arcadia_planitia }
	sr_site_clear_ties_arcadia_planitia = yes
	sr_site_sync_arcadia_planitia = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 5 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Arcadia Planitia and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_arcadia_planitia = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia has_variable = sr_free_ties_arcadia_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_arcadia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_arcadia_planitia }
	}
}
# Arcadia Planitia free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_arcadia_planitia = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia has_variable = sr_free_ties_arcadia_planitia } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_arcadia_planitia add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = arcadia_planitia }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_arcadia_planitia }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = arcadia_planitia }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_arcadia_planitia >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_arcadia_planitia value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_arcadia_planitia }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_arcadia_planitia value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_arcadia_planitia = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_arcadia_planitia
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 5 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Arcadia Planitia: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_arcadia_planitia = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_arcadia_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_arcadia_planitia value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_arcadia_planitia
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_arcadia_planitia
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_arcadia_planitia
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_arcadia_planitia >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = arcadia_planitia INDEX = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_arcadia_planitia >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_arcadia_planitia }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_arcadia_planitia value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 5 }
	}
}

# --- Ceres ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_ceres = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_ceres >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_ceres = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_ceres = yes
	}
}
# Ceres becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_ceres = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_ceres value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres }
	sr_site_sync_ceres = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_ceres }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES ceres is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Ceres back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_ceres = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_ceres }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_ceres value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_ceres value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_ceres value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_ceres }
	sr_site_clear_ties_ceres = yes
	sr_site_sync_ceres = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 6 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}

		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_ceres } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_ceres }

			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 9 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds 2 Pallas: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_pallas = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_pallas } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_pallas value = te_history_month_index } }

		name = sr_site_autonomy_pallas
		value = {

			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_pallas }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }

# --- 10 Hygiea ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_hygiea = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_hygiea >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_hygiea = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_hygiea = yes
	}
}
# 10 Hygiea becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_hygiea = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_hygiea value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hygiea }
	sr_site_sync_hygiea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_hygiea }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES hygiea is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes 10 Hygiea back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_hygiea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_hygiea }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_hygiea value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_hygiea value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_hygiea value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_hygiea }
	sr_site_clear_ties_hygiea = yes
	sr_site_sync_hygiea = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 10 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of 10 Hygiea and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_hygiea = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea has_variable = sr_free_ties_hygiea } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_hygiea } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_hygiea }
	}
}
# 10 Hygiea free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_hygiea = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_hygiea value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea has_variable = sr_free_ties_hygiea } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_hygiea add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = hygiea }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_hygiea }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = hygiea }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_hygiea >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_hygiea value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_hygiea }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_hygiea = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_hygiea value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_hygiea = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_hygiea
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 10 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds 10 Hygiea: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_hygiea = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_hygiea } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_hygiea value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_hygiea
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_hygiea
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_hygiea
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_hygiea >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = hygiea INDEX = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_hygiea >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_hygiea }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_hygiea value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 10 }
	}
}

	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES callisto is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Callisto back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_callisto = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_callisto }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_callisto value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_callisto value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_callisto value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_callisto }
	sr_site_clear_ties_callisto = yes
	sr_site_sync_callisto = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 14 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Callisto and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_callisto = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto has_variable = sr_free_ties_callisto } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_callisto } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_callisto }
	}
}
# Callisto free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_callisto = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_callisto value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto has_variable = sr_free_ties_callisto } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_callisto add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = callisto }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_callisto }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = callisto }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_callisto >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_callisto value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_callisto }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_callisto = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_callisto value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_callisto = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_callisto
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 14 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Callisto: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_callisto = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_callisto } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_callisto value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_callisto
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_callisto
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_callisto
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_callisto >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = callisto INDEX = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_callisto >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_callisto }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_callisto value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 14 }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_mercury >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_mercury value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_mercury }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_mercury = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_mercury value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_mercury = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_mercury
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 18 }
		}
	}
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_mercury } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_mercury value = te_history_month_index } }

		value = {

# --- Titan ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_titan = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_titan >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_titan = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_titan = yes
	}
}
# Titan becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_titan = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_titan value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titan }
	sr_site_sync_titan = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_titan }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titan }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES titan is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Titan back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_titan = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_titan }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_titan value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_titan value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_titan value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titan } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_titan }
	sr_site_clear_ties_titan = yes
	sr_site_sync_titan = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 19 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Titan and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_titan = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_titan has_variable = sr_free_ties_titan } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_titan } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_titan }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_titan } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_titan }
	}
}
# Titan free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_titan = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_titan value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_titan has_variable = sr_free_ties_titan } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_titan sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_titan add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = titan }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_titan } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_titan }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = titan }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_titan >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_titan value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_titan }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_titan = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_titan value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_titan = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_titan
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 19 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Titan: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_titan = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_titan } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_titan value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_titan
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_titan
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_titan
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_titan >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = titan INDEX = 19 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_titan >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_titan }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_titan value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 19 }
	}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_iapetus }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES iapetus is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Iapetus back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_iapetus = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_iapetus }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_iapetus value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_iapetus value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_iapetus value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus }
	sr_site_clear_ties_iapetus = yes
	sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 23 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Iapetus and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_iapetus = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus has_variable = sr_free_ties_iapetus } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_iapetus } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_iapetus }
	}
}
# Iapetus free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_iapetus = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus has_variable = sr_free_ties_iapetus } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_iapetus add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = iapetus }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_iapetus }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = iapetus }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_iapetus >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_iapetus value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_iapetus }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_iapetus = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_iapetus value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_iapetus = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_iapetus
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 23 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Iapetus: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_iapetus = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_iapetus } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_iapetus value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_iapetus
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_iapetus
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_iapetus
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_iapetus >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = iapetus INDEX = 23 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_iapetus >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_iapetus }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_iapetus value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 23 }
	}
}

			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_ariel } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_ariel }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = ariel }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_ariel >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_ariel value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_ariel }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_ariel = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_ariel value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_ariel = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_ariel
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 27 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Ariel: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_ariel = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_ariel } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_ariel value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_ariel
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_ariel
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_ariel
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}

		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_ariel >= sr_aut_break_level }

# --- Triton ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_triton = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_triton >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_triton = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_triton = yes
	}
}
# Triton becomes a free colony: no holder; its people, modules and discoveries stay.
sr_site_set_free_triton = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_free_triton value = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
	sr_site_sync_triton = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_triton }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES triton is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Triton back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_triton = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_triton }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_triton value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_triton value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_triton value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_triton }
	sr_site_clear_ties_triton = yes
	sr_site_sync_triton = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 28 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Triton and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_triton = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_triton has_variable = sr_free_ties_triton } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_triton } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_triton }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_triton } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_triton }
	}
}
# Triton free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_triton = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_triton value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_triton has_variable = sr_free_ties_triton } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_triton sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_triton add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = triton }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_triton } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_triton }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = triton }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_triton >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_triton value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_triton }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_triton = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_triton value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_triton = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_triton
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 28 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Triton: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_triton = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_triton } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_triton value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_triton
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_triton
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_triton
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_triton >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = triton INDEX = 28 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_triton >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_triton }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_triton value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 28 }
	}
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_charter_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES makemake is a free colony"
}
# THIS takes Makemake back from freedom (the petition, design § 3).
sr_site_rejoin_makemake = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_free_makemake }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_makemake value = this }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_autonomy_makemake value = sr_aut_rejoin_level }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_makemake value = te_history_month_index }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_makemake }
	sr_site_clear_ties_makemake = yes
	sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
	sr_site_gained_quiet = { INDEX = 32 }
	sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
}
# Every country's supply of Makemake and ties with it.
sr_site_clear_ties_makemake = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake has_variable = sr_free_ties_makemake } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_makemake } remove_variable = sr_free_ties_makemake }
	}
}
# Makemake free, its month (the global step): its suppliers counted, their ties
# grown and every other country's worn down, contact from a supplier, and once a
# year a petition to the supplier with full ties.
sr_site_free_step_makemake = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_makemake value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake has_variable = sr_free_ties_makemake } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake sr_free_can_supply = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_suppliers_makemake add = 1 }
			sr_free_ties_gain = { KEY = makemake }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake } remove_variable = sr_free_supply_makemake }
			sr_free_ties_decay = { KEY = makemake }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_suppliers_value_makemake >= 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_makemake value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_petition_makemake }
			any_country = { sr_free_may_petition_makemake = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_petition_makemake value = yes days = 365 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { sr_free_may_petition_makemake = yes }
			order_by = sr_free_ties_value_makemake
			max = 1
			sr_free_petition = { INDEX = 32 }
		}
	}
}
# THIS holds Makemake: its autonomy for the month, then its thresholds (design § 2).
sr_site_aut_step_makemake = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_makemake } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_contact_makemake value = te_history_month_index } }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = sr_site_autonomy_makemake
		value = {
			value = sr_site_autonomy_value_makemake
			add = sr_site_aut_drift_makemake
			min = 0
			max = sr_aut_break_level
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_site_autonomy_value_makemake >= sr_aut_break_level }
		sr_aut_break_away = { KEY = makemake INDEX = 32 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			sr_site_autonomy_value_makemake >= sr_aut_ask_level
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake }
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_aut_site }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_aut_asked_makemake value = yes days = 1825 }
		sr_aut_ask = { INDEX = 32 }
	}
}

# --- Haumea ---
# A dead holder's world with no heir: free when it holds people (simple and full), else released.
sr_site_free_or_release_haumea = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes sr_site_pop_value_haumea >= sr_free_colony_minimum }
		sr_site_set_free_haumea = yes
	}
	else = {
		sr_site_release_haumea = yes
	}

# Colony life (design § 7): one of THIS's colonies of at least MIN people, drawn
# evenly, into sr_life_site; nothing when none qualifies.
sr_life_pick = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris >= $MIN$ }
			set_variable = { name = sr_life_site value = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this sr_site_pop_value_olympus_mons >= $MIN$ }
			set_variable = { name = sr_life_site value = 2 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this sr_site_pop_value_hellas_planitia >= $MIN$ }
			set_variable = { name = sr_life_site value = 3 }

# The AI's supply review (sr_free_ai_review): free colonies THIS doesn't supply, in
# table order, while it supplies fewer than sr_free_ai_max.
sr_free_ai_supply_pick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris }
			sr_free_supply_count < sr_free_ai_max
		}
		set_variable = { name = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_free_olympus_mons
